definitions.gloss: one serving; one portion (for one person)
definitions.explanation: Used when ordering or describing food quantities.
Describes someone who has become competent or grown into a capable adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧{一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}すぎて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧きれなかった。
examples.english: One serving was too much and I couldn't finish it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant's servings are very large, so two of us split one serving.

examples.japanese: {一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧たい。
examples.english: I want to become a full-fledged adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I've finally become a full-fledged member of society.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{半人前|はんにんまえ}→半人前：22681_hanninmae⟧だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦いつか→いつか：01809_itsuka⟧{一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧たい。
examples.english: I'm still only half-qualified, but someday I want to become a fully-fledged craftsman.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦くせに→くせに：19730_kuseni⟧{一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧な。
examples.english: Don't talk like a grown-up when you're just a child.
examples.notes: {一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ is a set expression meaning to speak as if one were a competent adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十年|じゅうねん}→十年：noentry⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}して→修行：05522_shugyou⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: After ten years of training, I was finally recognized as fully qualified.

notes:
{一人前|いちにんまえ} has two related meanings.

SENSE 1 - FOOD PORTIONS:
- {一人前|いちにんまえ} - one serving
- {二人前|ふたりまえ} - two servings
- {三人前|さんにんまえ} - three servings

SENSE 2 - FULLY QUALIFIED:
- {一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to become full-fledged
- {一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧ - a fully qualified craftsman
- ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{半人前|はんにんまえ}→半人前：22681_hanninmae⟧ - still only half-qualified

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一人前|いちにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ - to talk like a grown-up
